newsitem.title: UK: UK's Newcastle Building Society year pretax falls.
newsitem.headline: UK's Newcastle Building Society year pretax falls.

text.p: Britain's Newcastle Building Society said on Tuesday its 1996 pretax profit fell to 11.5 million stg compared to 14.8 million stg a year earlier.
The mutually-owned company said net interest receivable fell to 24.0 million stg in 1996 from 28.3 million stg, and net lending rose 67 percent to a record 137 million stg.
Assets grew 11 percent to 1.56 billion stg.
"We remain committed to mutuality and recognise the need to demonstrate its real value," the company said in a statement.
"We will continue to explore ways to increase the value of being a member of Newcastle Building Society," it added.
